Essentia 2.1-beta5 (AGPL-3.0-or-later), https://github.com/MTG/essentia
Tag v2.1_beta5, commit ed59cc48e37ac33ac15b252fc5ad7af4b9ecd51d (2019-08-04), the
latest tagged release.

Licence: COPYING.txt (the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3) and
"Essentia Licensing.txt" (upstream's summary: Essentia's own code is AGPLv3,
or under a proprietary licence from the Universitat Pompeu Fabra on request;
the third-party code it carries keeps its own). AUTHORS and README.md are
upstream's. What this means for distributing SUBstation: docs/licensing.md.

What is here, copied by vendor.sh from a checkout of the tag:

- src/essentia: the core library (algorithms, their factories, parameters,
  types, pools, the streaming framework; TNT, public domain), without what
  reads or writes files and so needs FFmpeg, YAML or JSON (utils/audiocontext,
  ffmpegapi, jsonconvert, yamlast, metadatautils), the ready-made music and
  Freesound extractors, and the synthesis utilities.
- src/algorithms: only the 29 algorithms the sound similarity's extractor runs
  (intelligence/src/similarity/EssentiaExtractor.cpp) and those they create:
  vendor.sh's ALGORITHMS list.
- src/3rdparty/kiss_fft130: KISS FFT 1.3.0 (BSD-3-Clause, its COPYING), the FFT
  Essentia uses when configured with --fft=KISS: no FFTW (GPL).

Nothing else of Essentia is needed: no FFTW, FFmpeg/libav, libsamplerate,
libyaml, TagLib, Chromaprint, Gaia or TensorFlow. SUBstation decodes (and
resamples) audio itself and hands Essentia PCM.

Two files are upstream's build output, written by vendor.sh as upstream's
configure writes them (utils/algorithms_info.py): src/essentia/version.h, and
src/algorithms/essentia_algorithms_reg.cpp, which registers the algorithms
built (standard and streaming), as `--fft=KISS --include-algos=...` would.

Local changes, all in local-changes.patch, each file marked "Modified for
SUBstation on 2026-10-09" in its licence header (AGPLv3 section 5a):

- essentia/types.h, essentia/essentiamath.h, essentia/utils/peak.h: the
  std::binary_function base classes removed. They only declared typedefs
  nothing uses, and std::binary_function is gone from C++17 standard
  libraries (MSVC's, libc++).
- essentia/algorithmfactory.h: the explicit specializations of
  EssentiaFactory::_instance (defined in essentia.cpp) declared, so every
  translation unit using the factories knows of them (Clang warned
  -Wundefined-var-template; the program was ill-formed, no diagnostic
  required, without it).
- essentia/config.h: ESSENTIA_STATIC, which makes ESSENTIA_API empty: built as
  a static library, nothing is exported from (or imported into) the
  executables that link it.

How it is built (intelligence/CMakeLists.txt, the `essentia` target): every
.cpp here, as C++17, with upstream's include folders, ESSENTIA_STATIC and
DEBUGGING_ENABLED=0 (its logger's global state isn't thread-safe; several
analysers run its algorithms at once), its warnings not shown (upstream builds
with -w).

To update: check out another tag, set TAG, COMMIT and VERSION in vendor.sh,
run it, and fix local-changes.patch if it no longer applies. The extractor's
settings name Essentia's version, so fingerprints saved by the previous one
are made again.
